matching: Case-insensitive comparison against suggestion keywords. mustInclude entries are eligible relevant phrases the extractor should surface when the source supports them; mustExclude entries must never appear as suggestions for that source.

pm-rich.note: Reproduces the F5 audit input verbatim; Go must not match the go-to-market prefix.

senior-pm.note: Senior scope with platform vocabulary; AWS/Kubernetes are genuinely present and eligible.

sales-business.note: Non-PM business role; phrases must stay intact (no substring fragments).

engineering.note: Positive control: Go IS a genuine language requirement here and must be suggestible.

sparse.note: Honest small set: never pad with boilerplate to reach a count.
